summary.text: Celeste Rodriguez represents California's 43rd Assembly District, which consists of portions of Los Angeles County including the City of San Fernando, Sylmar, Pacoima, Arleta, Panorama City and Sun Valley.

paragraphs.text: She was elected to the San Fernando City Council in 2020 and became mayor, and she previously worked on homelessness prevention as part of the Los Angeles Mayor's Homelessness Services Team and as Deputy Director of Community Development Strategies.
Rodriguez was raised in the Northeast Valley, has an associate's degree from LA Mission College and a bachelor's degree in economics from San Diego State University, and lives in San Fernando.
